title: ur-ws close 2 of 2: approve the packet-skill edits and the new launch guard

calls.question: W5 edits the workstation's copy of Survey's approval-brief.md ahead of Survey's release. Approve it as written?

options.label: Approve as written and carry the two additions into Survey before its next release (backlog #79)
options.consequence: The stop-packet line and the round bullet are live now. The next update-skills run for Survey overwrites them with the pinned v1.7.0 text, with no warning, until Survey carries them.

options.label: Send back and make the brief's two changes in a Survey release first
options.consequence: W5 is held, acceptance item 2 stays unmet until the release exists, and W3 waits behind it.

evidence.text: The build design lists the vendored approval-brief.md among W5's files. The survey skill says to edit the file in the Survey repo only.
claude-tooling-sync verify does not compare a vendored file with its pin, so an overwrite gives no warning.

calls.question: The end-to-end outline of a round has ten faults the closing reviewer found. Accept the outline as evidence?

options.label: Accept the outline as evidence and fix the four round.md rules through backlog #81
options.consequence: W5 merges as it stands. Four wording rules in round.md that a later designer could misread stay as they are until #81 runs.

options.label: Send back, fix the four rules in this pass, and run the end-to-end check again
options.consequence: W5 is held and its executor relaunched. It edits round.md, a W4 file the pass's design leaves alone.

evidence.text: The outline holds all ten parts the acceptance item asks for. The reviewer found ten faults in it, B1 to B10, and the plan forbids editing the outline.
Backlog #81 names the four round.md lines the test reader misread.

steps.text: Merge #233 and #234 in that order with approval-queue merge and pull ~/.dotfiles with git pull --ff-only. No stow and no tooling apply.
Write the final report at ~/Projects/initiatives/.claude/worktrees/unattended-rounds/unattended-rounds/reports/ur-ws-report.md, with a row for each of the five passes, and end the round.

notChecked.text: Neither PR runs CI. The repo has no CI that tests a pull request, so each pass's run of the gate is the only check.
The launch guard in #234 is live as soon as ~/.dotfiles is pulled, because ~/.local/bin/claude-launch-guard links into the main checkout.

reviews.text: W5: whole-branch review accept, ten findings on the test outline left open as call 2.
W3: whole-branch review accept, no open finding, no call. It waits for your approve because you chose that for the launch guard and the CLAUDE.md change.
